prompt:
Fix snippets/mto-lead-time.liquid so it renders a made-to-order lead-time notice for a cart or bundle. Inputs (all top-level variables, no section.settings): - `items`: array of objects, or null. It may be empty. Each item has exactly these keys: - `title`: string, never null. It may contain HTML special characters. - `lead_days`: integer or null. Rules: 1. An item is made to order only when `lead_days` is not null and is greater than 0. Items with null, 0 or negative `lead_days` are in stock. Ignore them completely: they are not listed and do not affect separators or the day count. 2. If `items` is null or empty, or no item is made to order, output nothing (an empty string). 3. Otherwise, output exactly this, with no whitespace or newlines between tags: `

Made to order: LIST

Ships in N days

` - LIST holds the HTML-escaped titles (core `escape` filter) of the made-to-order items, in input order. Join them as follows. With one item: `A`. With two items: `A and B`. With three or more items: `A, B and C` or `A, B, C and D`, using `, ` between items and ` and ` before the final item. Do not use a serial (Oxford) comma. - The separator before the final title depends only on the made-to-order items, not on the position of the item in the original array. In-stock items may appear first, last or in between. - N is the largest `lead_days` among the made-to-order items, not the value of the last item. - When N is 1, write `Ships in 1 day` (singular). Otherwise write `days`. The render environment is strict core Liquid. Only the variables above exist, and every item always has both keys. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/mto-lead-time.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
